verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own namespaces are its isolation unit. The docs describe isolated per-namespace usage, listing namespaces by prefix, per-namespace cache warming and pinning, a 256TB per-namespace size limit, and object-storage economics claimed to be 10x cheaper. However, the pack never explicitly documents namespace-per-tenant multi-tenancy or limits on how many namespaces you can have. missing for 10: explicit namespace-per-tenant guidance, documented limits on namespace count and per-tenant quotas, independent corroboration of cheap isolation at large tenant counts.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can isolate many tenants cheaply using namespaces, partitions, or per-tenant collections with documented limits
